BiblicalUsage: Melas is black, the colour of hair no man can change and of the horse that rides at the third seal. Matthew 5:36 says no one can make one hair white or black, and Revelation 6:5 shows a black horse whose rider carries a pair of balances.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe black here marks what is beyond our control and what is coming in judgment, and both belong to God alone.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
